units.title: git-sync-stop bounded push
units.intent: Add bounded timeout to git-sync-stop hook push so it cannot run unsupervised/detached.

units.title: .gitignore hygiene + helper audit
units.intent: Clean .gitignore and audit helper files via git add/rm to shrink git status noise.

units.title: orphan reaper Stop hook
units.intent: New stop_close_prism_nodes_v2.mjs Stop hook to reap orphan git.exe/node processes after Stop.

units.title: archive 23 disabled hooks
units.intent: Move 23 disabled hook source files out of settings.json into a manifest-tracked archive.

units.title: mirror direction enforcement
units.intent: Enforce one-way C:->H: direction in c-to-h-mirror hook (or replacement).

units.title: hybrid handoff store + 2 dispatcher actions
units.intent: New HandoffCoordinatorEngine with hybrid store, wired into sessionDispatcher as 2 new actions.

units.title: ID resolution hardening (mandate stdin)
units.intent: Harden stable-session-id/per-agent-handoff ID resolution to mandate stdin-sourced IDs.

units.title: compact pipeline consolidation (5+ files -> 2)
units.intent: Consolidate the precompact/postcompact hook pipeline from 5+ files down to 2.

units.title: startup pipeline read path
units.intent: Add session-handoff-load.mjs to read the handoff store at session startup.

units.title: Obsidian vault integration (NTFS junction)
units.intent: Integrate handoffs into an Obsidian vault via NTFS junction with frontmatter convention.

units.title: Quartz HTML build (port 8766)
units.intent: Build a Quartz HTML dashboard served on port 8766 via a daemon-supervisor.

units.title: context-bundle daemon
units.intent: New context-bundle-daemon.mjs producing a freshness-stamped context bundle, reusing daemon-supervisor.

units.title: ONE prompt-context-inject hook
units.intent: Replace per-hook injection with a single prompt-context-inject.mjs hook reading the bundle.

units.title: browseable context dashboard
units.intent: Quartz-based browseable dashboard for all injection content via context-html-builder.mjs.

units.title: retire 30+ redundant hooks
units.intent: Retire 30+ redundant hooks from settings.json into a disabled-hooks batch archive.
